newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian UES rise on restructuring news.
newsitem.headline: Russian UES rise on restructuring news.

text.p: Shares in Russian electric company Unified Energy Systems (UES) rose sharply in volatile trading in a generally firmer market on Tuesday on news the government intended to tighten control over its management, dealers said.
At 1300 GMT UES was $0.1980, off an earlier $0.1995 high, after closing on Monday at $0.1890.
Earlier First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov said the government blamed UES management for a payments crisis, and may increase control over the utility.
UES shares have been fluctuating in recent weeks amid uncertainty over government reform intentions towards it.
